telemetry.gp-exfil.test.summary: FIXTURE. Carries a javascript: URL on purpose: the sync gate should strip it, and every render site should refuse it even if an older sync stored it.
remediation: Block the host at the egress proxy

wildcards.title: GUINEA PIG: attacker-controlled subdomain space
